Load a BirdNET Model

Source: R/model_load.R
birdnet_load.Rd

Load BirdNET models for sound identification or for species prediction from location and time. Models are downloaded on first use.

  • birdnet_load(): an official BirdNET model (acoustic or geographic).

  • birdnet_load_perch(): the Perch v2 acoustic model.

  • birdnet_load_custom(): a custom classifier trained with BirdNET-Analyzer.

  • birdnet_inspect_custom(): describe a custom TFLite classifier without loading it.

Every successful load prints one line naming the loaded model; silence it with suppressMessages().

Usage

birdnet_load(
  type = "acoustic",
  version = "3.0",
  backend = NULL,
  library = NULL,
  precision = "fp32",
  language = "en_us"
)

birdnet_load_perch(device = "CPU")

birdnet_load_custom(
  model,
  species_list,
  type = "acoustic",
  version = "auto",
  backend = "tf",
  library = NULL,
  precision = "fp32",
  check_validity = TRUE,
  is_raven = NULL
)

birdnet_inspect_custom(model, library = NULL)

Arguments

type

character. "acoustic" or "geo".

version

character. Model version, "3.0" or "2.4". For custom classifiers "auto" reads it from the file (TFLite only).

backend

character or NULL. "onnx", "tf", "pt" or "pb".

library

character or NULL. "litert" or "tflite". Only applies to backend = "tf".

precision

character. "fp32", "fp16" or "int8".

language

character. Language of the common species names, e.g. "en_us". See birdnet_list_languages().

device

character. "CPU" (default) or "GPU" (see birdnet_use_gpu()).

model

character. Path to the custom classifier: a .tflite file for backend = "tf", a directory for backend = "pb".

species_list

character. Path to the label file of the custom classifier.

check_validity

logical. Check that the model can be loaded before using it.

is_raven

logical or NULL. Only for backend = "pb": is the classifier a Raven export? NULL (default) uses the default of the birdnet Python package: TRUE for a 2.4 classifier, FALSE for a 3.0 one. Set FALSE for a 2.4 classifier that is not a Raven export.

Value

A BirdNET model object (S3 class birdnet_model with type-, backend- and version-specific subclasses). Use it with birdnet_predict(), birdnet_encode() (acoustic models) and birdnet_list_species(). Internal list fields are implementation details and should not be relied upon.

birdnet_inspect_custom() returns a named list describing a custom TFLite classifier: version (base model, "2.4" or "3.0"), mode ("replace" or "append"), n_species, applies_sigmoid, supports_encoding and input_samples (NULL if any input length is accepted).

Details

type:

  • "acoustic": identify species in audio recordings.

  • "geo": predict which species occur at a location and week of the year.

version: "3.0" (BirdNET+ V3.0, the default) or "2.4".

backend:

  • "onnx": ONNX Runtime (3.0 only). Part of the default installation; the default for 3.0.

  • "tf": TensorFlow Lite (TFLite) model, CPU only. The default for 2.4.

  • "pt": PyTorch (3.0 only), CPU or GPU. Installs birdnet[pt] on first use.

  • "pb": TensorFlow SavedModel (Protobuf), CPU or GPU. Installs birdnet[tf] on first use.

If backend is NULL, it follows the version: "onnx" for 3.0 and "tf" for 2.4.

library only applies to backend = "tf":

  • "litert": the LiteRT interpreter, part of the default installation on the platforms listed below.

  • "tflite": TensorFlow's own interpreter. Installs birdnet[tf] on first use.

If library is NULL, LiteRT is used where it is available (Linux, macOS on Apple silicon, Windows on x86-64), otherwise "tflite". The geo 3.0 model always uses "tflite".

precision: "fp32", "fp16" or "int8"; not every model supports every precision.

Heavy runtimes (TensorFlow for "pb", "tflite" and Perch; PyTorch for "pt") are not part of the default installation. They are added automatically the first time a model needs them, which can take a while.

The Perch v2 model is not supported on Intel Macs.

Use birdnet_list_models() for all valid combinations and which ones need an extra download.

Examples

if (FALSE) { # \dontrun{
# BirdNET+ V3.0 acoustic model (default)
model <- birdnet_load()

# BirdNET V2.4 and the V3.0 geo model
model_24 <- birdnet_load(version = "2.4")
geo <- birdnet_load(type = "geo")

# Perch v2
perch <- birdnet_load_perch()

# A custom classifier trained with BirdNET-Analyzer: describe it, then load it
birdnet_inspect_custom("path/to/CustomClassifier.tflite")
custom <- birdnet_load_custom(
  model = "path/to/CustomClassifier.tflite",
  species_list = "path/to/CustomClassifier_Labels.txt"
)
} # }
